image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a car wheel attached to a red vehicle. The wheel features a polished silver/chrome multi-spoke alloy rim (5 main Y-shaped spokes) with a deep dish design. A black rubber tire is mounted on the rim, showing visible sidewall lettering ('COOPER COBRA') and tread details. Behind the spokes, brake calipers and rotors are partially visible. The background includes the red fender of the car and asphalt ground.

artifact_observations.location: Inner barrel of the rim (behind the spokes)
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is faint, illegible text or marking etched into the inner barrel of the rim. While real custom wheels sometimes have engravings, AI often generates nonsensical scribbles in these hard-to-render areas. It is barely noticeable but lacks clear semantic meaning.

The mechanical components behind the spokes (brakes/suspension) are slightly indistinct and 'mushy' compared to the sharpness of the rim face. This is common in AI generation where internal mechanics are guessed rather than rendered precisely.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of wheel (alloy vs steel) and verify it matches the 'car wheel' class label with high confidence.
To rigorously audit the legibility and correctness of the 'COOPER COBRA' text, ensuring no character-level artifacts or gibberish.
To check for edge bleeding or fusion between the polished metal rim and the black rubber tire, a common failure point in AI images.
To assess overall photorealism, lighting consistency on the chrome reflections, and detect any subtle global distortions.

focus_areas: Legibility and semantic correctness of tire sidewall text
Sharpness and physical plausibility of the rim-tire interface
Structural integrity of the spoke connections to the hub
Reflection consistency on the polished metal surfaces
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the tire. AI models often fail to render specific brand names like 'Cooper Cobra' correctly, resulting in near-miss spellings or warped characters. Also, inspect the reflection on the chrome rim; ensure the reflections align with the environment (red car body) and do not show contradictory or impossible light sources. Check the brake components behind the spokes for structural nonsense.
